**A practical school of computing**

> 务实的计算学院

## Why it matters (为何重要)

Georgia Tech's computing tradition favors systems that ship — SQLite and Google News both trace back here.

> 佐治亚理工的计算传统偏爱能落地的系统——SQLite 与 Google News 都源于此。

## Background (背景)

Established in 1885 as the Georgia School of Technology and opened in 1888 to 84 students, it was renamed Georgia Institute of Technology in 1948.

> 1885 年以“佐治亚技术学校”之名创立，1888 年招收 84 名学生，1948 年更名为佐治亚理工学院。

## People (人物)

| Person | Connection to computing |
|:--|:--|
| Krishna Bharat | created Google News during his MIT/Georgia Tech CS studies. **D. Richard Hipp** (1984) — architect and primary author of the SQLite database engine |
| Andy Hunt | co-author of *The Pragmatic Programmer* and an original signatory of the Agile Manifesto |

> **Krishna Bharat** — 在开发 Google News 前于佐治亚理工取得计算机硕士与博士学位。**D. Richard Hipp**（1984 届）— SQLite 数据库引擎的架构师与主要作者。**Andy Hunt** — 《程序员修炼之道》合著者、敏捷宣言签署人。
